title.zh: K 个不同整数的子数组

desc.zh: 从手算到两个左边界：用至多计数相减，恰好数出 k 种值的连续区间。
desc.en: Derive two left boundaries and subtract at-most counts to count exactly-k intervals.

complexity: O(n) expected time; O(n) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Exactly-k via at-most subtraction
concepts.description: Cancel intervals with fewer distinct values.

concepts.name: Earliest valid start invariant
concepts.description: Repair frequency windows and count valid starts.
